A '''testing probe''' was a kind of tool. After the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Information broker/Legends|informant]] [[8t88/Legends|8t88]] lost an [[Limb/Legends|arm]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]<ref name="Rebel Agent" /> during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]'' to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].</ref> [[Gender/Legends|he]] attempted to repair himself after traveling to the moon [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]] for business related to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. While attaching a new arm to his body, 8t88 asked his [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] [[Rol (Human)|Rol]] to hand him a [[tuning stylus]], but instead received a testing probe, as Rol could not tell the difference between the two tools. 8t88 angrily discarded the testing probe and used the tuning stylus to install his new arm with.<ref name="Rebel Agent" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ill-detailed testing probe first appeared in the [[1998]] novella ''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]'', which was written by [[William C. Dietz]]. The nature of the probe was not explicitly defined, although due to the name it is arguably used for testing.<ref name="Rebel Agent" /> The tool also briefly appears in ''Rebel Agent''{{'s}} [[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|audio drama adaption]]. However, it is not explicitly identified in the audio drama.<ref name="Audio Drama">[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Rebel Agent'' audio drama]]</ref>
